label: No act done at every accessible world strictly yields a contingent effect
note: Unconditional (in the frame semantics): SIMPLICITY-COLLAPSE-CORE has no premises and its first clause excludes STMT-NECESSARY-ACT-STRICT-CONTINGENT (MODAL-FORK-CONTROLS, RivalNegations). It constrains the root route's account of creation (#462, #555): a necessary root whose act is performed at every accessible world cannot create contingently by a strictly efficacious act. It is not a rival of a root premise, so no alternative_to is recorded.
